title: 第1章 龙落凡尘，凶手就是你
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
【开元一年，你的父亲姜渊立国，国号景，同年出生的你被立为太子，奈何遭遇奸人掳走，幸得高人救下，逃过一劫，你获得生存奖励——修仙功法‘道法自然功’】
【开元二年，你被高人清虚道长带到龙起观，偶遇大师兄练武，险被打死，幸得二师兄所救，逃过一劫，你获得生存奖励——武学‘神影腿’】
【开元四年，京城迎来地震，龙起观崩塌，你险些被房梁砸死，幸得大师兄所救，逃过一劫，你获得生存奖励——武学‘九寻天龙步’】
【开元五年，天降大寒，流感肆乱京城，你不幸染疾，幸得三师姐采集药草医治，逃过一劫，你获得生存奖励——杂术‘春秋医典’】
【开元六年，开国大将军曹虎豹造反被镇压，躲入龙起观，被你撞见，曹虎豹对你出手，幸得师父所救，逃过一劫，你获得生存奖励——法器‘麒麟拂尘’】
清晨时分，第一缕阳光划破连连青山，驱逐黑暗，照在一座阁楼顶层上，一座古老的铜钟悬在半空中，旁边有一位少年道士正在发呆。
正是十二岁的姜长生，每日清晨敲钟之前，他都会回顾前半生的经历，来给自己强打精神。
一夜习武让他犯困，好在他的职责很简单，就是每日准时敲钟，提醒道观上下该起床念道经，自六岁起接下此任务，他就没有再遇到磨难，日子变得清闲，不过靠着已经获得的功法、武学、医术，他的生活也不会乏味。
姜长生的生存系统来自于前世，前世他是一名游戏研发员，他开发了一款游戏，噱头便是‘倘若你能长生，你能在修仙界活多久’。
玩家的寿命是无限的，但会被杀死，在修行路上会遇到各种磨难、诱惑，姜长生自己试过，最多活了一万多岁，很有挑战性。
这款游戏不是简单的选择游戏，是需要实际操作、探索的，即便一直躲在一个地方，也可能遇到天灾，总而言之，就是一句话，人生福祸难料。
游戏上架后短时间内便火起来，因看后台数据过于激动，长期熬夜的姜长生猝死在电脑前，继而投胎在这一世。
这一世，他不敢保证自己是否真的长生，需要过几十年再知晓，在此之前，他要依靠生存奖励变强，强大到足以面对人生的劫难。
道法自然功卡在第二层，但神影腿与九寻天龙步已然完全掌握，春秋宝典博大精深，他只是熟记了内容，还未运用过，至于法器，他还未修炼出灵力，无法使用，此宝保留在他的脑海深处，待他修炼到道法自然功第四层，炼就灵力便可掌握，如今他体内只有真气，真气可以使得武学更具威能。
阳光洒在身上，姜长生打了一个哈欠，双手握住旁边吊着的木桩，开始敲钟。
钟声回荡在群山间，悠久绵长，好似在催动岁月的流动，配合着天地间的青山绿水，彰显出岁月静好的宜人氛围。
敲一次，停五息时间，连敲十次，姜长生方才松手。
“今日的摸鱼生活又开始了。”
姜长生哼着小曲开始下楼，他穿着灰蓝色道袍，阳光照耀下衣摆随风飘动，别有一番仙韵。
刚下楼，一名十五六岁的道士跑过来，停在他面前大口喘气，满头大汗，他急声道：“长生师弟，大事不好……昨晚有宾客死在观内，师父传你前往明心殿……”

姜长生皱眉，他知晓近日有朝堂官员前来做客，没想到会死人，看这位师兄的架势，死者身份不低。
他习惯每晚悄悄练武，龙起观又不小，昨晚他还真没发现异常。
他也不多想，跟着师兄前往明心殿。
“长生师弟，你不知晓，那位状元太厉害了，仅凭尸体就算出死亡时间、死因以及死前死者的活动……”
“死者乃是吏部官员，据说权力还不小，竟然有人敢在京城行刺官吏，啧啧，真是离谱……”
听着师兄的话，姜长生差点翻白眼。
这就离谱？
我可是景朝第一位太子，他娘的还被人调包了，最关键的是竟然没有被发现，那假冒货如今还高坐太子宝座上，名传天下。
有我的遭遇离谱？
姜长生心中叹气。
这是一个类似华夏古代的异世界，姜长生在娘胎里便能听到外面的声音，这个世界说的还是汉语，得知自己出生在皇室，他很激动，而且还是开国初期，当父皇跟他母后说，册立胎中的他为太子时，他感觉此生要巅峰了。
他的母亲与父皇是结发夫妻，陪着父皇从草莽崛起，历经磨难，打遍天下，建立新朝，在这样的背景下，他只要登基，应该能有美满的一生。
可惜，天不遂人愿，奸人可恶！
过去已然过去，姜长生不再多想，他取名长生，足以见得他现在的志向。
半柱香时间后，姜长生跟随着师兄来到明心殿前，明心殿不算太大，庭院内聚集着观内弟子，上百人将此地围得水泄不通，殿门还有宾客们的奴仆守候，足有二三十人。
见到姜长生前来，弟子们纷纷投来目光，他虽在龙起观内很低调，但长相俊美的他存在感可不低。
“师弟，进去吧，师父找你。”
一名女弟子开口道，龙起观并非传统的道门，更像是江湖门派，有男有女。
姜长生点头，信步走入殿内。
他一眼便看到躺在地上被白布盖着的尸体，右侧站着道长清虚以及三位大弟子，左侧是做客龙起观的六位宾客，站在最前面的是一名书生打扮的男子，也是姜长生路上听说的状元，陈礼。

他一入殿，陈礼便在打量他。
姜长生来到清虚道长面前，弯腰行礼，道：“师父。”
清虚道长便是小时候救他的人，他一直很敬重，别看清虚道长外貌严肃，但观内的规矩并不多，全观上下皆是他的徒弟，弟子之间没有辈分之差，相处很和谐。
清虚道长手握拂尘，白发苍苍，仙风道骨，他微微点头，道：“长生，跟陈施主说说你昨晚去哪儿了？”
姜长生转身看向陈礼，道：“昨晚我去练功了，同舍的师弟与师父知晓我有这个习惯。”
他怎么可能隐藏六年，自六岁起习武，那年年末他就被清虚道长撞见，他只说自己是悟出来的，反正刚练时招式不连贯，清虚道长倒也没有多想，还指点了几句，之后几年，大师兄、二师兄、三师姐也陆续发现此事，不过他们没有将此事透露给其他弟子，任由他深夜习武。
在普通弟子眼里，姜长生只是一名低调的同门。
在三大弟子眼里，他是一名武道奇才，年纪轻轻就能自创武学。
大师兄李长青少年时便自创过一种拳法，如今还推行给年少弟子学习。
陈礼问道：“敢问小道长在哪儿练功？”
姜长生回答道：“道钟楼前，我习惯练完功就上楼敲钟，白日再摸……听道法。”
他很自然，一点也不紧张，反正人不是他杀的，而且他压根不认识死者。
陈礼旁边的一位中年男子开口道：“我观小兄弟细皮嫩肉，双手光滑无茧，不像是习武之人，也不知小兄弟练的是什么功？”
语气咄咄逼人，落在姜长生耳朵里有些刺耳。
陈礼笑道：“小道长别介意，我们已经排查一个时辰，我身边的诸位已经自证清白，他们都是凡夫，不懂武学，只能从贵观内寻找，当然，我们不是怀疑贵观，也可能有贼人易容成贵观弟子。”
姜长生从小到大就没有离开过京城，入观后更是没有离开过道观，所以不清楚外界的易容术达到什么程度。
他回答道：“练的是内功。”
凡是达到六岁的弟子，可自己取名，并学习龙起观的内功心法，姜长生假装学习，实则修行的是修仙功法道法自然功。
能修仙，为何修武？
之所以说内功，是因为他的武学皆是腿脚之法，万一死者是死于这类武学之下，那就误打误撞？

陈礼目光灼灼的问道：“传闻龙起观的真心经独步武林，皇帝陛下龙威尚弱时，清虚道长以真心经一夫当关，救皇帝陛下于危难之际，真心经一旦催动，双眸会变得异常明亮，如黑夜里的明珠，小道长练功数载，应该已经起步，不知可否展示？”
二师兄孟秋河笑道：“我这位师弟天资绝伦，内功自然已经起步，或许还小成，长生，给他们展示一下。”
姜长生尴尬了。
他压根没有练真心经，谁让清虚道长又不会检查弟子们的练功状况。
真心经还有特效？
我怎么不知道？
姜长生开始头脑风暴。
听闻孟秋河的话，殿外的弟子们议论纷纷，能得二师兄的夸奖，莫非姜长生真是习武奇才？
众目睽睽之下，姜长生只能坦白：“抱歉，我练的不是真心经，我喜欢自创武学，目前内功还在探索之中，至于武学……”
陈礼打断道：“你刚好修炼的是脚法，对吗？”
姜长生愣住，诧异的看向陈礼。
陈礼弯腰，掀开摆布，只见死者是一名男子，年轻力壮，手指上还有玉器扳指，说明不是劫财，只是仇杀。
陈礼将其胸膛拉开，其胸骨塌陷，伤势偏长，仿佛是被人重重踩了一脚。
这么巧的吗？
姜长生终于意识到，自己遭殃了，平静六年，厄运还是来了。
死者涉及官吏，一旦他被抓出去，清虚道长保不了他，那麻烦就大了。
当初清虚道长救他时，那些奸人可是见过清虚道长的模样，说明那群人知晓他的落脚处。
姜长生在被奸人掳走的那段期间也听闻了他们的身份，文武大臣皆有，甚至涉及开朝元勋，这是一场水很深的惊天密谋，他们必然在等着姜长生离开道观。
清虚道长因以前救过皇帝姜渊，被皇帝记恩行赏，所以龙起观是京城内唯一的武林门派，衙门不得擅查，军队也不得擅入。
“小道长，你怎么不说话了，莫非凶手就是你？”陈礼目光灼灼的盯着姜长生道。
content_en:
[In the first year of Kaiyuan, your father Jiang Yuan founded the country, and the country was named Jing. You were born in the same year and were made the prince. However, you were kidnapped by traitors. Fortunately, you were saved by an expert and escaped. You received a survival reward - the cultivation method of immortality, 'Tao Law Natural Skill']
[In the second year of Kaiyuan, you were brought to Longqi Temple by the master Qingxu Taoist Master. You met your senior brother practicing martial arts by chance and were almost beaten to death. Fortunately, you were rescued by your second senior brother and escaped. You received a survival reward - the martial arts ‘Shadow Leg’]
[In the fourth year of Kaiyuan, there was an earthquake in the capital, and the Longqi Temple collapsed. You were almost killed by a beam. Fortunately, you were saved by your senior brother and escaped. You received the survival reward - the martial arts ‘Nine-Xun Tianlong Steps’]
[In the fifth year of Kaiyuan, there was a severe cold and influenza ravaged the capital. Unfortunately, you got sick. Fortunately, the third senior sister gathered herbs to treat you and escaped. You received a survival reward - Zashu's "Spring and Autumn Medical Code"]
[In the sixth year of Kaiyuan, the founding general Cao Hubao rebelled and was suppressed. He hid in Longqi Temple. You ran into him. Cao Hubao attacked you. Fortunately, you were saved by your master. You escaped and you received a survival reward - the magic weapon 'Kilin Whisk']
In the early morning, the first ray of sunlight breaks through the green mountains, driving away the darkness, and shines on the top floor of an attic. An ancient copper bell hangs in the air, and a young Taoist priest is in a daze next to it.
It was twelve-year-old Jiang Changsheng. Before ringing the bell every morning, he would review his experiences in the first half of his life to cheer himself up.
A night of practicing martial arts made him sleepy. Fortunately, his duty was very simple, which was to ring the bell on time every day to remind everyone in the Taoist temple to get up and recite Taoist sutras. Since he took over this task at the age of six, he has no more hardships and his life has become leisurely. However, relying on the martial arts, martial arts, and medical skills he has acquired, his life will not be boring.
Jiang Changsheng's survival system came from his previous life. In his previous life, he was a game developer. He developed a game. The gimmick was 'If you can live forever, how long can you live in the world of immortality'.
The player's lifespan is unlimited, but they will be killed, and they will encounter various hardships and temptations on the road to practice. Jiang Changsheng has tried it himself, and he has lived for more than 10,000 years at most, which is very challenging.
This game is not a simple choice game, it requires actual operation and exploration. Even if you have been hiding in one place, you may encounter natural disasters. In short, in one sentence, life's blessings and disasters are unpredictable.
The game became popular in a short time after it was released. Jiang Changsheng, who had stayed up late for a long time, died suddenly in front of the computer because he was too excited to see the background data, and was reincarnated in this life.
In this life, he can't guarantee whether he will truly live forever. It will take decades to find out. Before that, he has to rely on survival rewards to become strong enough to face the catastrophes of life.
The Taoist Natural Technique is stuck at the second level, but the Divine Shadow Leg and the Nine-Xun Tianlong Step have been fully mastered. The Spring and Autumn Book is vast and profound. He has only memorized the content but has not used it yet. As for the magic weapon, he has not yet developed spiritual power and cannot use it. This treasure remains deep in his mind. When he reaches the fourth level of the Taoist Natural Technique, he can master it with spiritual power. Now he only has true energy in his body, which can make martial arts more powerful.
As the sun shone on his body, Jiang Changsheng yawned, held the wooden stake hanging next to him with both hands, and began to ring the bell.
The sound of the bell echoes in the mountains, long and long, as if it is urging the flow of time. Together with the green mountains and green waters between heaven and earth, it highlights the quiet and pleasant atmosphere of time.
Knock once, pause for five breaths, and knock ten times in a row before Jiang Changsheng let go.
"Today's fishing life has begun again."
Jiang Changsheng hummed a little tune and started to go downstairs. He was wearing a gray-blue monk's robe, and the hem of his clothes fluttered in the wind under the sunlight, giving him a unique charm.
Just as he came downstairs, a Taoist priest of fifteen or sixteen years old ran over and stopped in front of him, gasping for air and sweating profusely. He said urgently: "Junior Brother Changsheng, something bad happened... A guest died in the temple last night. Master told you to go to Mingxin Hall..."
Jiang Changsheng frowned. He knew that some court officials had come recently.As a guest, I didn't expect that someone would die. Judging from the posture of this senior brother, the deceased's status was not low.
He is used to practicing martial arts quietly every night, and Long Qiguan is not small. He really didn't notice anything unusual last night.
He didn't think too much and followed his senior brother to the Mingxin Hall.
"Junior Brother Changsheng, you don't know that the top scholar is so powerful that he can calculate the time of death, cause of death, and the activities of the deceased just from the corpse..."
"The deceased was an official from the Ministry of Personnel. It is said that he had quite a lot of power. Someone actually dared to assassinate an official in the capital. Wow, that's outrageous..."
Jiang Changsheng almost rolled his eyes after listening to his senior brother's words.
Is this outrageous?
I am the first prince of the Jing Dynasty, and he was actually transferred to someone else. The most important thing is that he was not discovered. The counterfeit is still sitting on the throne of the prince, and his reputation is spread all over the world.
Is my experience outrageous?
Jiang Changsheng sighed in his heart.
This is a different world similar to ancient China. Jiang Changsheng could hear sounds from outside while he was still in his mother's womb. This world still spoke Chinese. He was very excited to learn that he was born into the royal family. This was also in the early days of the founding of the country. When his father and mother told his mother that he would be crowned prince, he felt that his life was about to reach its peak.
His mother and father were married, and they accompanied him to rise from the wilderness, go through hardships, conquer the world, and establish a new dynasty. Under this background, as long as he ascends the throne, he should be able to have a happy life.
It's a pity that God doesn't fulfill people's wishes, and the traitors are disgusting!
The past is gone, Jiang Changsheng no longer thinks about it anymore. He named Changsheng, which is enough to show his current ambition.
After half a stick of incense, Jiang Changsheng followed his senior brother to the front of the Mingxin Hall. The Mingxin Hall was not too big. The temple disciples gathered in the courtyard. Hundreds of people surrounded the place. There were also servants of the guests waiting at the door of the hall. There were twenty or thirty people.
Seeing Jiang Changsheng coming, the disciples all looked at him. Although he was very low-key in Longqi Temple, his presence was not low due to his handsome appearance.
"Junior brother, go in, master is looking for you."
A female disciple said, Longqi Temple is not a traditional Taoist sect, but more like a Jianghu sect, with both men and women.
Jiang Changsheng nodded and walked into the hall.
At a glance, he saw the body lying on the ground covered with white cloth. On the right side stood the Taoist priest Qingxu and three major disciples. On the left side were the six guests of Long Qiguan. Standing at the front was a man dressed as a scholar, who was also the number one scholar Jiang Changsheng heard about on his way, Chen Li.
As soon as he entered the palace, Chen Li was sizing him up.
Jiang Changsheng came to Taoist Master Qingxu, bowed and saluted, and said: "Master."
Taoist Priest Qingxu was the person who saved him when he was a child. He has always respected Taoist Priest Qingxu. Despite Taoist Priest Qingxu's serious appearance, there are not many rules in the temple. Everyone in the temple is his disciple. There is no seniority difference between the disciples and they get along harmoniously.
Taoist Master Qingxu held a fly whisk in his hand. He had gray hair and an immortal spirit. He nodded slightly and said, "Changsheng, tell Almsgiver Chen where you were last night?"
Jiang Changsheng turned to look at Chen Li and said, "I went to practice last night. My fellow juniors and master knew that I had this habit."
How could he hide for six years and practice martial arts since he was six years old? At the end of that year, he was bumped into by Taoist Master Qingxu. He only said that he had realized it. Anyway, the moves were inconsistent when he first practiced. Taoist Qingxu didn't think much about it and gave some pointers. In the next few years, the senior brother, second senior brother, and third senior sister also discovered this one after another, but they did not disclose it to other disciples and allowed him to practice martial arts late at night.
In the eyes of ordinary disciples, Jiang Changsheng is just a low-key fellow disciple.
In the eyes of the three major disciples, he is a martial arts wizard who can create his own martial arts at a young age.
Senior brother Li Chang created a boxing technique when he was a teenager, and now he teaches it to young disciples.
Chen Li asked: "May I ask where the little Taoist master practices?"
Jiang Changsheng replied: "In front of the Taoist bell tower, I am used to going upstairs to ring the bell after practicing, and then touch it again during the day...to listen to the Taoist teachings."
He is very natural and not nervous at all, anyway, he didn’t kill the person, and he didn’t know the deceased at all.
A middle-aged man next to Chen Li said: "I see that my little brother has thin skin and tender flesh, and his hands are smooth and calloused. He doesn't look like a martial artist. I don't know what kind of martial arts he practices?"
The tone was aggressive, which was a bit harsh in Jiang Changsheng's ears.
Chen Li smiled and said: "Don't mind, little Taoist priest. We have been investigating for an hour. Everyone around me has proven their innocence. They are all ordinary people and do not know martial arts. They can only look for them from Guiguan. Of course, we are not doubting Guiguan. There may be thieves disguised as disciples of Guiguan."
Jiang Changsheng has never left the capital since he was a child, and he has never left the Taoist temple after entering the temple, so he doesn't know the extent of the outside world's disguise skills.
He replied: "What I practice is internal strength."
All disciples who reach the age of six can name themselves and learn the internal skills and mental methods of Longqi Guan. Jiang Changsheng pretends to learn, but in fact he practices the immortal skills, Tao methods and natural skills.
If you can cultivate immortality, why cultivate martial arts?
The reason why I say internal strength is because his martial arts are all based on leg and foot techniques. What if the deceased died due to this type of martial arts, then what if he was hit by accident?
Chen Li asked with burning eyes: "It is rumored that Long Qiguan's True Heart Sutra is unique in the martial arts world. When His Majesty the Emperor's dragon power was still weak, Taoist Master Qingxu used the True Heart Sutra to save His Majesty the Emperor in times of danger. Once the True Heart Sutra is activated, his eyes will become extremely bright, like pearls in the night. The little Taoist priest has been practicing for several years and should have started. I wonder if I can show it?"
The second senior brother Meng Qiuhe smiled and said: "My junior brother is extremely talented, and his internal strength has naturally started. He may have achieved some success and achieved immortality. Let's show it to them."
Jiang Changsheng was embarrassed.
He didn't practice the True Heart Sutra at all, and Taoist Master Qingxu didn't know how to check the practice status of his disciples.
Does the True Heart Sutra have special effects?
How come I don't know?
Jiang Changsheng started brainstorming.
After hearing what Meng Qiuhe said, the disciples outside the hall started talking a lot. To be praised by the second senior brother, could it be that Jiang Changsheng is really a martial arts prodigy?
